newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks sink in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks sink in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks sank in early Tuesday morning trade after U.S. markets closed weaker overnight, brokers said. They said participants were opting for the sidelines, but bargain-hunting interest was healthy and the Nikkei index would probably not collapse.
At 0015 GMT, the Nikkei 225 was 174.49 points or 0.85 percent lower at 20,247.55. Its March futures were down 170 points at 20,240.
"Support appears to be near the 20,000 level, but closer to 20,500, gains are hard to accumulate," Hiroshi Morimoto, general manager at Daiwa Securities, said.
